item.title: Students gather outside the education ministry
item.description: Students gathered outside the ministry on Monday morning.
item.content:encoded:
Students gathered outside the education ministry on Monday morning, the third such assembly in a fortnight. Organisers said the turnout exceeded four thousand, while the district administration put the figure closer to twelve hundred.

The ministry did not respond to a request for comment. Traffic on the arterial road was diverted for six hours, and metro services at the nearest station were suspended between ten and two.

item.title: Ministry says no talks are scheduled
item.description: The ministry said no talks were scheduled.
item.content:encoded:
The education ministry said on Tuesday that no talks with the organisers were scheduled, and that a committee constituted last month would submit its findings in due course. Organisers called the statement an evasion and said the assembly would continue.

A senior official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said the department had not been asked to prepare a negotiating position.
